Subject: VP/CTO Intro: Redwood Inference demo & technical deep-dive

Thanks again for your time this morning — really appreciated the context on your latency/cost targets and the gating items for a pilot. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

Recap
- Current: mix of on-prem GPUs + cloud endpoints; struggling with consistent p99 latency and unexpected token costs at scale.
- Goals: 50% reduction in per-token cost for inference workloads, p99 latency <150ms for 512-token sequences, and simpler rollout for private deployments.
- Constraints: procurement window Q2, security/compliance review needed (SOC2 + audit logs), VP/CTO buy-in required for pilot.

Proposed next steps
1) Executive alignment call (VP/CTO intro) — 30 min to align on business metrics and SLA expectations. This will unblock procurement.
2) Technical deep-dive / demo — 60 min with our SE to go through architecture, data flows, and a short live demo on a representative request pattern.

I pulled together a short demo deck (attached) and a proposed agenda for the two meetings. Can you please confirm who from your side should join the exec alignment? I recommend VP + CTO (or delegated exec + CTO).

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Mar 16: 9:00–10:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed Mar 17: 11:00–12:00 or 16:00–17:00

If easier, feel free to pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min. I can put both meetings on the calendar (exec + technical) back-to-back if that works.

Attachments: redwood_demo-deck.pdf (2MB) — short overview + architecture + pricing scenarios.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
